g.text: Single-mutant predictions: all 119 sites x 19 substitutions
Shared symmetric color scale centered at zero; no smoothing or clipping
Gray x = WT identity (not calculated). * = site within 10 A of a truncated terminus. Black dot = model confidence High.
Numbers mark scores <= -0.50 or >= +1.50 only; these are screening bands, not uncertainty bounds. Full values: all_results_with_features.tsv.
